flags: Comcast completed the spin-off of Versant, a company holding certain former cable networks and digital platforms, as an independent public company.
Comcast completed the sale of its Sky operations in Germany.
Comcast announced its intention to split into two independent public companies through a tax-free spin-off of NBCUniversal and Sky. It is expected to complete in mid-2027, subject to conditions.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited item (business description); the revenue-type mapping is inferred from the business and segment descriptions
business_model.claim: Comcast describes itself as a global media and technology company. It sells connectivity and platform services (broadband, wireless, video, voice) and also creates content and runs theme parks.
quotes: We are a global media and technology company that reaches customers, viewers and guests worldwide through the connectivity and platforms services we provide and the content and experiences we create.

business_model.claim: Reporting is organised into two primary businesses and five segments: Connectivity & Platforms (Residential Connectivity & Platforms, Business Services Connectivity) and Content & Experiences (Media, Studios, Theme Parks).
quotes: We present the operations of (1) our Connectivity & Platforms business in two segments: Residential Connectivity & Platforms and Business Services Connectivity; and (2) our Content & Experiences business in three segments: Media, Studios and Theme Parks.

business_model.claim: Customers span the United States, United Kingdom and Italy for connectivity and video. Content & Experiences serves global audiences and runs theme parks in the United States and Asia.
quotes: Contains our broadband, wireless, video and wireline voice businesses in the United States, United Kingdom and Italy

business_model.basis: stated in the income statement and release tables; the explanation of the decline is stated in the MD&A (P4), which is not cited here
business_model.claim: Connectivity & Platforms is the larger business by revenue. In the third quarter it produced 19,663 of consolidated revenue of 29,298, against 10,537 for Content & Experiences (table in millions). Consolidated revenue fell versus the prior-year quarter's 31,198.

business_model.basis: figures stated in the release; the mechanism is inferred from the release and the management commentary in P4
business_model.claim: In the largest segment, Residential Connectivity & Platforms, the third-quarter revenue lines moved in different directions. Domestic broadband was 6,241 against 6,550 a year earlier (a (4.7%) change). Domestic wireless service was 1,050 against 915 (14.7%). Video was 5,910 against 6,475 ((8.7%)) (table in millions).

business_model.basis: stated in the release table (customer counts in thousands); the bundling link is stated in P1
business_model.claim: Customer counts drive recurring connectivity revenue. In the third quarter domestic residential broadband customers were 28,343 thousand after net losses of (144) thousand, and domestic video customers were 10,394 thousand after net losses of (274) thousand. Domestic wireless lines rose by 368 thousand to 10,555 thousand.

Management deliberately trades near-term broadband revenue per customer for retention and customer growth. It simplified broadband pricing and gives a free wireless line for a year to new and existing domestic broadband customers.
quotes: In 2025, we simplified our broadband pricing structure and began offering a free wireless line for one year to new and existing domestic broadband customers, which we expect will improve customer retention and strengthen our ability to compete for new customers, but will negatively impact average domestic broadband revenue per customer.

business_model.claim: Domestic wireless is sold through an MVNO arrangement. Comcast rents network capacity from Verizon rather than owning a wireless network, and third-party access fees and device costs appear in direct product costs.
quotes: Our domestic wireless services are offered over Verizon’s wireless network

Direct product costs primarily consist of access fees related to using wireless and broadband networks owned by third parties to deliver our services and costs of products sold, including wireless devices and Sky Glass smart televisions.

business_model.claim: Programming is the main cost of the video business and moves with video subscribers and per-subscriber rates. Third-quarter residential programming expense was 3,624 against 3,952 a year earlier, a (8.3%) change (table in millions).
quotes: We expect programming expenses for our video services to continue to be the largest single expense item for our Residential Connectivity & Platforms business and to continue to increase on a per subscriber basis.

business_model.basis: figures stated in the release; the growth drivers are stated in the 10-K discussion (P3), not cited here
business_model.claim: Business Services Connectivity (Comcast Business, serving small businesses and enterprises) is the smaller, higher-margin and growing connectivity segment. Third-quarter revenue was 2,645 (table in millions), up 2.7%, with an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 55.9% against 56.4%.

business_model.basis: stated in the release tables; the mechanism is inferred from the cited percentage changes

Media earns money from advertising, distribution fees paid by video providers, and international networks. Third-quarter Media revenue was 5,359 (table in millions) against 4,744, up 13.0%. Excluding the FIFA World Cup, revenue was 5,136, up 8.3%.

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items; the 10-K comparison is stated in P3, not cited in this claim

increased depreciation due to the opening of Epic Universe in May 2025

Our customer relationship additions/(losses) continue to be negatively impacted by an increasingly competitive environment.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items' tables; mechanism inferred from the residential revenue lines

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items; mechanism inferred from the segment tables

As consumers increasingly turn to DTC streaming services in lieu of linear video services, which continue to experience accelerated net customer losses, our video customers and video revenues, and linear television network subscriber fees received from video service providers, each decrease.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item (risk factors)
